title: Nice Variety of Decor
text: Nice Variety of Decor. If you're new to tiered tray decorating, then this is a good set for you. It has a nice variety of items. The wooden blocks look mass produced, but they're not bad. Their paint job is just too perfect! I like that this comes with the garland, gnome, and beads, too. This is not enough to fill one full tray at my house. I try to make sure mine has items on all sides, not just the front. But it is a good start.
